dish.title: Oven-Barbecued Baby Back Ribs with Corn and Quick Pickles
dish.description: Baby back ribs rubbed with brown sugar, smoked paprika, and chili powder, baked low and slow in foil until tender, then lacquered with a homemade tangy molasses barbecue sauce and broiled until sticky and caramelized. Served with boiled sweet corn and crisp quick-pickled cucumbers and red onion.

recipe_version.title: Oven-Barbecued Baby Back Ribs with Corn and Quick Pickles
recipe_version.description: Baby back ribs rubbed with brown sugar, smoked paprika, and chili powder, baked low and slow in foil until tender, then lacquered with a homemade tangy molasses barbecue sauce and broiled until sticky and caramelized. Served with boiled sweet corn and crisp quick-pickled cucumbers and red onion.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp rub, 1 tsp pickles, 1 tsp corn pot

steps.title: Preheat and rub
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 275 F to preheat with a rack in the middle. Pull the thin membrane off the bone side of each rack with a paper towel. Mix 3 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, the chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, 1 tbsp salt, and the pepper; rub all over the ribs. Wrap each rack tightly in heavy-duty foil, meat side up, and set on a sheet pan.

steps.title: Slow-bake
steps.body: Bake the foil packets in the preheated 275 F oven 2 1/2 hours, until the meat has pulled back from the bone ends and is very tender.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: During the bake, simmer the ketchup, 1/4 cup cider vinegar, molasses, Dijon, the remaining brown sugar, and the remaining smoked paprika in a small saucepan over medium-low, stirring, until thick, 15 minutes. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Quick-pickle
steps.body: Also during the bake, stir 1/2 cup cider vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tsp salt until dissolved; pour over the cucumbers and red onion and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Heat the broiler and sauce the ribs
steps.body: Take out the ribs, set the rack 6 inches below the broiler, and turn the broiler on high to preheat for 5 minutes. Carefully open the foil, move the racks meat side up to a clean foil-lined sheet pan, and brush thickly with sauce. Broil 4 minutes, brush again, and broil 3 to 4 minutes more until sticky and caramelized at the edges. Watch closely so the sugar does not burn.

steps.title: Boil the corn
steps.body: While the broiler heats and the ribs broil, bring 16 cups (4 quarts) water and 1 tsp salt to a boil in the large pot (start it at the end of step 2), add the corn, and boil 5 minutes. Runs inside steps 2 and 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.body: Rest the ribs 5 minutes, cut between the bones, and serve with the corn, the drained pickles, and the remaining sauce.
